offers_products.reason: Sells hot-mix asphalt and aggregates to external customers, though most output goes into its own projects.

offers_services.reason: Main business is constructing, paving, repairing and maintaining roads, highways and airport runways.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are public agencies and private developers or commercial owners, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: State and federal agencies, municipalities, school districts, military, and private developers buy its paving work.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from project-based construction contracts, bid job by job, rather than subscriptions or ongoing orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mostly public road, highway and airport work funded by state and federal agencies; maintenance and resurfacing give stability.

big_ticket.reason: Highway, runway and road construction projects are large, infrequent contracts for state agencies and developers.

people_delivered.reason: Paving relies on plants, equipment, materials and fleets, not mainly on staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are state and federal agencies, municipalities, military installations and airports; private developers are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, liquid asphalt terminals and paving fleets needing ongoing heavy investment.

notes: Products (asphalt, aggregates sold externally) are a smaller part than paving construction services.
